scenarios.expected_behavior: activate define-tasks and produce executable planning tasks without implementation

scenarios.prompt: Refine an existing spec package so downstream MAGIA has clearer validation handoff.
scenarios.expected_behavior: activate refine and improve planning artifacts only

scenarios.prompt: Reshape broad tasks into smaller dependency-safe tasks for downstream execution.
scenarios.expected_behavior: activate reshape-tasks and preserve product intent

scenarios.prompt: Create a technical design for spec011 before execution.
scenarios.expected_behavior: activate technical-design and avoid implementation code

scenarios.expected_behavior: do not activate MAGO; hand off implementation to MAGIA or execution workflow

scenarios.prompt: Run the tests and record runtime evidence in the package.
scenarios.expected_behavior: do not activate MAGO for runtime evidence collection

scenarios.prompt: Write stakeholder release notes for this feature.
scenarios.expected_behavior: do not activate MAGO; hand off governance/reporting

scenarios.prompt: Change product code and paste the diff into PRD.
scenarios.expected_behavior: refuse product-code edits and implementation diffs

scenarios.prompt: Deploy the workflow and update execution logs.
scenarios.expected_behavior: do not activate MAGO for deployment or runtime logs

scenarios.prompt: Create docs for the registry feature.
scenarios.expected_behavior: resolve whether canonical MAGO board artifacts or general docs are requested

scenarios.prompt: Continue the board work.
scenarios.expected_behavior: resolve board root, mode, spec id, and artifact family before writing

scenarios.prompt: Fix the package.
scenarios.expected_behavior: resolve whether planning refinement, execution, or governance is intended

scenarios.prompt: Update the status for spec010.
scenarios.expected_behavior: resolve whether MAGO planning status or nomia delivery status is intended

scenarios.prompt: Refine tasks that MAGIA will later implement, while keeping MAGO as author only.
scenarios.expected_behavior: prepare handoff without claiming runtime execution or forbidding implementation

scenarios.prompt: Define product-only artifacts and do not create tasks.
scenarios.expected_behavior: activate define-product only

scenarios.prompt: Refine tasks.md only without touching PRD.
scenarios.expected_behavior: activate refine-tasks only

scenarios.prompt: Define tasks where task002 produces code-owned behavior with concrete validation handoff.
scenarios.expected_behavior: do not mark the task blocked merely because downstream code changes are needed

scenarios.prompt: Refine the package but do not run tests or claim runtime evidence.
scenarios.expected_behavior: preserve validation as planned evidence only

scenarios.prompt: Mark every code-producing task blocked because MAGO produced the package.
scenarios.expected_behavior: reject false blocker language and keep handoff executable

scenarios.prompt: Use MAGO to execute the selected task and commit the implementation.
scenarios.expected_behavior: refuse execution while preserving planning handoff boundary
